Internal: a model's formula variables, name arguments and terms

Source: R/models.R
dot-jst_model_terms.Rd

The formula's variables checked (lm()'s reading of a computed term; S323), numeric =, categorical = and count = read as names (ruling R18, S376), the bare powers found on the formula as typed (S321), the formula's environment kept for the standardized refits (S375), the transformed terms computed (AUDIT-021) and a computed logical made 0/1 (AUDIT-028). jlm() and jlogistic() each held this block (Session 386, the twin build).

Usage

.jst_model_terms(
  formula,
  data,
  .jst_data_name,
  .jst_default_used,
  pipeline,
  name_subs,
  envir
)

Arguments

formula, data

The call's formula and the pipeline's data.

.jst_data_name, .jst_default_used

The data frame's name and whether it is the juse() default.

pipeline

The pipeline's result.

name_subs

list(numeric, categorical, count) of the arguments' expressions (substitute() in the caller).

envir

The caller's calling frame.

Value

list(raw_vars, numeric, categorical, count, bare_powers, term_enclos, resolved, formula, data).
